purpose: Teach: 古墳/打破/祈祷/側近/優等生/邦画/長嶋/乱入

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、古墳、絶対、出土品の盗難、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're actively investigating the theft of artifacts from that burial mound. We truly appreciate your trust.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Professional without coldness. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. Slight pause between clauses — the rhythm of official procedure. Warm undertone on the closing gratitude.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 組織犯罪、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、打破、絶対、目指しているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the police are working to dismantle organized crime networks, then—is that right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Leans forward slightly in attention. Genuine curiosity, not interrogation. Breath catch before the clarifying question. Voice rises gently at the end, inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。神社の、本気で、絶対、祈祷、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、いたしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's correct. We're also providing security for the shrine during its purification ceremonies.
lines.style: Factual, unrushed. Each point lands as confirmation. No defensiveness—just straightforward professional detail. Slight nod in the voice. Steady eye level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 要人の、本気で、絶対、側近、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応、絶対、ですか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And that includes protection for VIPs and their close staff during the ceremonies?
lines.style: Careful, respectful inquiry. Slightly smaller voice than before—checking for sensitivity of the topic. Genuine question, not accusation. Pause after VIPs, inviting clarification.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。学校の、本気で、絶対、優等生、絶対、への、絶対、防犯教室、絶対、警察、絶対、開催しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've also been conducting crime-prevention workshops at local schools, working with students on awareness and safety.
lines.style: Slightly warmer than before. Touch of purpose in the delivery—this part clearly matters to him. Steady pace. Each example given with equal weight. Finishing with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 有名な、本気で、絶対、邦画、絶対、撮影現場、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I see. The police also handled security for that famous film production that shot nearby, didn't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful recollection. Slightly softer tone—acknowledging something outside the immediate crisis. Testing ground with the example. Voice steady but reflective, not seeking approval but remembering.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。野球の、本気for、絶対、長嶋、絶対、関連イベント、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's right. We provided security coordination for the Nagashima-related baseball event last month as well.
lines.style: Return to procedural tone. Matter-of-fact listing of responsibility. No pride in it, but no apology either. Simple statement of what was done. Solid, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 施設への、本気で、絶対、乱入、絶対、事件、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、いただいているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And I understand the department also responded quickly when there was that incident with the unauthorized entry at the community center?
lines.style: Softer close. Appreciative in tone without flattery. The question arrives as acknowledgment rather than interrogation. Slight warmth on the closing. Voice settles, inviting affirmation.
